canonical_statement: Let X be a smooth projective variety over a characteristic-zero field k and L an ample invertible sheaf on X. Then H^i(X, omega_X tensor L) vanishes for every natural degree i > 0.
domain_and_universes: universe u; k : Type u with Field k and CharZero k; D : KodairaVanishingData k contains X : Scheme.{u}, its structure morphism to Spec k, and three actual X.Modules objects K, L, and KTensorL; i : Nat; the target is Prop.
hypotheses: k is a field of characteristic zero
X is integral and smooth over Spec k
X is projective over Spec k
K models the canonical and dualizing sheaf omega_X
L is an invertible, locally free rank-one, ample sheaf
conclusion: Subsingleton (D.Cohomology i) for every i : Nat with 0 < i, where D.Cohomology i is definitionally the pinned mathlib Sheaf.H type of the underlying abelian sheaf of D.KTensorL.
minimal_import_basis: Modules.Sheaf supplies Scheme.Modules and SheafOfModules.toSheaf; Morphisms.Smooth supplies the concrete smoothness and integral-scheme surface; SheafCohomology.Basic supplies Sheaf.H; Topology.Sheaves.Abelian plus GrothendieckCategory.HasExt supply the concrete HasExt instance required to elaborate H at the pinned default heartbeat limit. Removing either of the last two leaves the cohomology typeclass obligation unresolved, and no aggregate Mathlib import is used.
encoding_boundary: Pinned mathlib has no combined native scheme-level APIs for projective morphisms, canonical or dualizing sheaves, invertible locally free rank-one sheaves, ampleness, or their sheaf tensor product. KodairaVanishingData therefore uses actual Scheme and Scheme.Modules carriers with named semantic proposition boundaries for exactly those missing notions. No field contains, implies by definition, or assumes cohomology vanishing. The cohomology family is not opaque: it is the concrete pinned Sheaf.H type.

degenerate_and_boundary_cases: Degree zero is excluded. The field is arbitrary of characteristic zero rather than silently specialized to Complex or assumed algebraically closed. X is integral, so a disconnected or reducible smooth projective scheme does not broaden the intake word variety. Positive characteristic, singular, nonprojective, merely nef, noninvertible, and nonample cases are excluded. Dimension zero is not excluded, but its positive-degree claim cannot provide proof credit for other dimensions.
